## System Overview
Y1 Game is a high-performance Indian skill-based online gaming portal engineered for Android and iOS PWA clients. The platform provides GLI-certified provably fair Random Number Generator (RNG) games, including Aviator Pro, 13-Card Rummy, and Teen Patti with 60-second automated UPI/IMPS bank withdrawals.
